stories.headline: Europe orders €388 million AI supercomputer
stories.summary: EuroHPC selected France's Bull to build LUMI-AI in Finland using AMD processors, IBM storage and Nokia networking. The publicly funded system is expected online in the second half of 2027.

stories.headline: Watchdog flags AI cyber risk to financial system
stories.summary: Financial Stability Board Chair Andrew Bailey called AI-enabled cyberattacks the most immediate AI concern for global finance, citing faster attacks, weak safeguards and dependence on a few technology providers.

stories.headline: US emergency oil reserve nears practical floor
stories.summary: The Strategic Petroleum Reserve holds 289.7 million barrels, its lowest level since 1982. Further planned releases could leave less flexibility during disruptions; operational limits and replenishment timing remain debated.

stories.headline: Nepal races to reach workers trapped in tunnels
stories.summary: Nepal says 903 people are dead and 4,247 missing after the Himalayan flood. Rescue teams are trying to reach 933 hydropower workers, many trapped in tunnels; further flood and landslide risks persist.

stories.headline: Russian drone barrage on Kyiv enters fifth day
stories.summary: Near-continuous Russian drone attacks are disrupting Kyiv transport and daily life. Monday's strikes injured four people and damaged civilian and commercial sites; both sides report intensified infrastructure attacks.
